rationale: Classify this exact form as a repository write. Committed ReviewVcsV3 evidence measured `git commit -zn` in a fresh Git 2.56.0 repository with a staged tracked-file modification: it exited 0 and emitted NUL-terminated status, HEAD remained unchanged, but `.git/index` changed and an unreferenced tree object was created. Index and object-database mutations count as writes; a ref update is not required. This expectation is grounded in that prior committed observation, not a command execution in this assignment.
